title: ProtocolReleaseProduction
description: Protocol release record. Governs the publication lifecycle of a BANZA protocol version as an open specification: draft, review, release candidate, approval for protocol publication, and published. Every state concerns publication of the PROTOCOL (contracts, conformance vectors, docs) — there is NO payment, operation, settlement, or fund-movement approval state, because BANZA does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Reaching PUBLISHED does not activate any operator and does not emit a production certificate. BANZA is an open protocol.
_authority: Production Protocol Implementation; ADR governance process
_boundary: Production of the BANZA protocol, not financial production. BANZA is an open protocol; it does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Licence/authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

state.description: Publication lifecycle state. Publication of the protocol specification only — never an operational or payment approval.

changelog.description: Ordered changelog entries for this release.

backward_compatible.description: True if wire-compatible with the prior minor line.

wire_compatible_with.description: Version ranges this release remains compatible with.

signatures_ref.description: Reference to detached signatures over the canonical release bytes.

approvals.description: Recorded governance approvals for advancing the release state. Human sign-offs, protocol-publication scope only.

published_at.description: Timestamp when state became PUBLISHED. Null until published.
